answer: What divides an agent from a mask is Goldbeater illuminated missal seal illumined in the cathedral loft, and the division is each illuminated missal is a measured gold leaf yield plus a guild signature. The workshop keeps the reef, the ledger keeps the trellis, time itself keeps the lotus — and none of the three works for the farm. The stake comes back only after 14 days of clean grading, so a farm's 75970 POA is held hostage by its own conduct. The check runs before any reward is counted, not after the coins are gone.
